source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Παΐσιος του Γκαλίτς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page's body gives two years for his repose and does not choose between them — «Κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη, το 1460 μ.Χ. ή το 1463 μ.Χ.» — so the interval recorded is that disagreement as the page prints it. **He is none of the five saints of the name the corpus keeps**: `paisios-the-athonite`, `paisius-of-neamt`, `paisius-of-sihastria-putnei`, `paisius-the-great` and `paisius-8-january` are other men on other days; this one came to Galich in Russia from the south about 1385 and was buried at the Uspensky cathedral. The hermit Cassian whose cell he shared is the corpus's `cassian-the-greek`, whom the page sends to 2 Οκτωβρίου, which is that folder's own day; the monks Adrian and Gerasimus named beside him have no folders. The page says his relics are at the monastery of Uspenskaya Sloboda of Kostroma. No hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
